items.example: It's a lovely flat. That said, it's miles from the station.
items.exampleTr: Çok güzel bir daire. Bununla birlikte istasyondan çok uzak.
items.simple: You say something good, then add something that is not so good.
items.note: Önceki cümleye karşı bir nokta eklerken kullanılır.

items.example: He's rude. Mind you, he's had a hard year.
items.exampleTr: Kaba biri. Ama şunu da söyleyeyim, zor bir yıl geçirdi.
items.simple: You add a small fact that makes what you said before feel a bit different.
items.note: Çok İngiliz bir kalıp; sohbet havasında.

items.example: As it happens, I'm free on Friday.
items.exampleTr: Tesadüfen Cuma günü boşum.
items.simple: You say this when something is true by chance, and it is a surprise.

items.example: Come to think of it, I haven't seen Ali all week.
items.exampleTr: Düşününce, Ali'yi bütün hafta görmedim.
items.simple: You say this when a new thought suddenly pops into your head.

items.example: He can't complain, and by the same token, neither can I.
items.exampleTr: O şikayet edemez, aynı mantıkla ben de edemem.
items.simple: You use this when the same reason works for another thing too.

items.example: It's cheap. Having said that, the quality isn't great.
items.exampleTr: Ucuz. Bunu söylemişken, kalitesi pek iyi değil.
items.simple: You say one thing, then you say something that goes the other way.
items.note: that said ile hemen hemen aynı.

items.en: at the end of the day
items.example: At the end of the day, it's your decision.
items.exampleTr: Sonuçta karar senin.
items.simple: This means: when you think about everything, this is the most important thing.

items.example: For what it's worth, I think you did the right thing.
items.exampleTr: Değeri ne olursa, bence doğru olanı yaptın.
items.simple: You say this when you give your idea, but you are not sure it will help.

items.example: Be that as it may, we still have to finish by Monday.
items.exampleTr: Öyle de olsa, Pazartesi'ye kadar bitirmemiz gerek.
items.simple: You say this to accept a point, but then you go on with your own idea.
items.note: Biraz resmi ve kararlı bir ton.

items.example: Speaking of which, did you pay the rent?
items.exampleTr: Lafı açılmışken, kirayı ödedin mi?
items.simple: You say this to talk about something that just came up in the chat.

items.example: By and large, people here are friendly.
items.exampleTr: Genel olarak buradaki insanlar cana yakın.
items.simple: This means mostly. It is true most of the time, but not always.

items.example: All things considered, it went pretty well.
items.exampleTr: Her şey göz önüne alındığında oldukça iyi geçti.
items.simple: You look at every good and bad part, then say what you think overall.

items.example: I might be late, but in any case, start without me.
items.exampleTr: Geç kalabilirim, ama her halükarda bensiz başlayın.
items.simple: This means: it does not matter what happens, this will stay the same.

items.example: I'm not angry. If anything, I'm a bit relieved.
items.exampleTr: Kızgın değilim. Hatta biraz rahatladım.
items.simple: You say this to say a small thing that is more true than what people expect.

items.example: It's expensive, not to mention noisy.
items.exampleTr: Pahalı, gürültülü olmasından bahsetmiyorum bile.
items.simple: You add one more thing, and it makes the first things even bigger.

items.en: as far as I can tell
items.example: As far as I can tell, nobody has noticed yet.
items.exampleTr: Anlayabildiğim kadarıyla henüz kimse fark etmedi.
items.simple: This means: from what I can see, but I may not know everything.

items.example: Incidentally, have you spoken to Sarah lately?
items.exampleTr: Bu arada, son zamanlarda Sarah'yla konuştun mu?
items.simple: You use this when you say something extra that is not the main talk.

items.example: Admittedly, I didn't try very hard.
items.exampleTr: Kabul etmeliyim ki pek çaba göstermedim.
items.simple: You say a thing is true, even though it is a bit hard to say.

items.example: Granted, it's not perfect, but it works.
items.exampleTr: Tamam, mükemmel değil ama işe yarıyor.
items.simple: You say yes, that part is true, and then you give your own point.

items.example: It was raining. We went out nonetheless.
items.exampleTr: Yağmur yağıyordu. Yine de dışarı çıktık.
items.simple: It means even so. Something stays true even if something else is not.

items.example: Only one thing matters now, namely, the deadline.
items.exampleTr: Şu an tek bir şey önemli, yani son teslim tarihi.
items.simple: You use it before you say exactly which thing you mean.

items.example: I love mornings, whereas my brother hates them.
items.exampleTr: Ben sabahları severim, oysa kardeşim nefret eder.
items.simple: You use it to show two things that are very different from each other.

items.example: He helped, albeit very slowly.
items.exampleTr: Yardım etti, gerçi çok yavaş.
items.simple: It means although. You say it before a small thing that is less good.

items.example: Strictly speaking, you're not allowed to park here.
items.exampleTr: Kesin konuşmak gerekirse, buraya park etmen yasak.
items.simple: Using the exact rules, not just what people usually do.

items.example: Broadly speaking, people here are quite friendly.
items.exampleTr: Genel olarak buradaki insanlar oldukça cana yakın.
items.simple: Talking about the big picture, not every little detail.

items.example: Let's circle back to this after lunch.
items.exampleTr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra buna tekrar dönelim.
items.simple: To come back to a topic later, after you talk about other things.

items.en: Anyway, as I was saying, we need more time.
items.tr: Neyse, dediğim gibi, daha fazla zamana ihtiyacımız var.
items.example: Anyway, as I was saying, we need more time.
items.exampleTr: Neyse, dediğim gibi, daha fazla zamana ihtiyacımız var.
items.simple: You go back to your first idea after someone stopped your talk.
